devanagari.text: चूकी पिआसा पूरन आसा गुरमुखि मिलु निरगुनीऐ ॥

english.default: Says Nanak, in the Home of my God, the songs of joy are continuously, continually heard. ||4||1||

translation.spanish: dice Nanak, en el Recinto de mi Maestro, escucha continuamente la Melodía de mi Dios. (4-1)
